channel.title: The Luverne Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Luverne Journal (luvernejournal.com)

item.title: March marks Developmental Disabilities Awareness month
item.description: March is Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month in Alabama, highlighting 120,000 residents and ADMH services that support independence, community life and lifelong opportunities.

item.title: CCA crowns 'Big Apple' winners
item.description: Crenshaw Christian Academy’s 2026 “Big Apple Edition” pageant crowned winners from kindergarten to Miss CCA, led by Miss CCA 2026 and evening gown winner Emilee Jacobs.

item.title: Partners to host second Senior Citizen Summit
item.description: Crenshaw County to host free Senior Citizen Summit March 27, offering fraud and scam prevention tips from law enforcement and state agencies at Tom Harbin Agricultural Center.

item.title: Brantley Bulldogs claim hard-fought state championship
item.description: Senior guard Jackson Mitchell hits last-second winner as Brantley Bulldogs edge Hubbertville 45-44 for their first AHSAA 1A state basketball title since 1995.

item.title: Faith Community Calendar
item.description: Area faith events: first responder breakfast, food pantry, Living Last Supper services, appreciation dinner and missions meeting with speakers from Sav-A-Life and Gift of Love.

item.title: Journalist, radio host shares overcomer story
item.description: Blind journalist and radio host Conner Howell shares his path to journalism with Luverne Kiwanians as the club readies a charity golf tournament and honors luncheon for seniors.

item.title: Second strawberry festival coming March 17
item.description: Second annual CPC Strawberry Festival returns to Luverne March 17, offering homemade strawberry shortcake to raise funds for children's programs, books and scholarships.

item.title: The command was issued
item.description: Rev. R.A. Mathews reflects on Iraq airstrikes, Daniel’s vision, and what the Bible says about heaven, angels, and a God who hears our prayers.

item.title: Turn around, look at me
item.description: A frog fable, a jealous church member, and biblical lessons on ego show why seeking credit can cost more than it gives, and why believers are called to serve for God, not applause.

item.title: Cougars swing into baseball season
item.description: Crenshaw Christian’s young Cougars open the 2026 baseball season under coach Zack Ward, leaning on senior and JV leaders after a 10-0 win and a 13-12 loss.
